- [Essay 32: From Retrofit to Architecture – Operationalizing ADA Title II Compliance Before the Deadline](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-32-from-retrofit-to-architecture/): Why downstream post-production LMS accessibility retrofits fail at scale, and how upstream Curriculum-as-Code CI/CD linters bake WCAG 2.2 AA (9:1) compliance into the source repository.

- [Essay 29: The Upstream Shift: Why Post-Production Accessibility Is a Failure of Architectural Design](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-29/): Why remediating broken LMS pages after publication fails at scale, and how born-accessible Markdown SSoT eliminates remediation backlog.
- [Essay 28: Beyond Performative Compliance: ADA Title II & Living Conformance Statements](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-28/): Replacing static VPAT PDFs with continuous, programmatic accessibility telemetry across live LMS course fleets.

## Turnkey $0 ZTC OER, NSF AI-Ready America 50-State Enabling Resource & K-16 Dual-Enrollment Datasets
- **Institutional Infrastructure & U.S. DOL TEN No. 07-25 Framework ([EN](https://alanpruitt.com/institutional-infrastructure/) • [ES](https://alanpruitt.com/es/institutional-infrastructure/))**: Non-Competing 50-State Enabling Partner reference architecture mapping the 5 Foundational Content Areas and 7 Community College Delivery Design Principles of U.S. DOL ETA TEN No. 07-25 directly to Curriculum-as-Code (`S-A-R`), air-gapped Apple Silicon Ollama / Gemma inference, ADA Title II (`9:1` Double-Contrast Guard), and dual-namespace (`EXW` -> `KIN / HLTH`) OER syndication.
- **Non-Competing 50-State Enabling Resource (`NSF TechAccess: AI-Ready America` & AWC Southwest Arizona AI Symposium)**: Alan Pruitt and Webcognita LLC **do not compete** against community colleges, universities, or state consortia for primary [NSF TechAccess: AI-Ready America](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/initiatives/ai-ready) grant awards. Instead, we serve as a proven technical readiness resource, open Curriculum-as-Code reference architecture, and subaward implementation partner supporting **Arizona Western College** (building on the regional momentum of the AWC-hosted **Southwest Arizona AI Symposium**) and **State & Territory AI-Ready Coordination Hubs across all 50 states**. We transition cohorts from `AI-AWARE` to `AI-READY` using **air-gapped, zero-cloud-footprint local inference** (**Google Gemma E2B/E4B**, **LiteRT-LM**, **Android AICore**, **Apple Silicon Ollama Carbon 4**, triple-hash `###` token isolation, and parallel local subagents via the **Antigravity CLI & SDK**) across higher education, rural agriculture, small businesses, and high-OPSEC/FERPA environments—while our S-A-R compiler absorbs shifting federal portal mandates (including **Executive Order 14434**, *Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence*, `91 FR 63129`, bridging federal **Super Intelligence [`SI`]** nomenclature with **`15 U.S.C. § 9401(3)`** statutory AI definitions and human-in-the-loop safety governance) via single-source JSON-LD updates with zero drift.
